fluff.overview: Field artillery platoons operate indirect-fire weapons capable of delivering explosive rounds at ranges measured in kilometers. These crew-served systems provide area bombardment, terrain denial, and suppressive fire that conventional direct-fire infantry cannot match. Artillery platoons require forward observers or spotting data to engage targets beyond line of sight, and their slow displacement rate makes them vulnerable to counter-battery fire. Properly emplaced and supported, however, a single artillery platoon can shape the battlefield across an entire sector.
